name: 89031 · N Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89031 (N Las Vegas) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89031 (N Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89031 (N Las Vegas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
